description: This Java class 'SensorLogger' manages logging sensor data to a file, including initializing log files, writing sensor values periodically, and handling sensor-specific naming based on debug modes.

classes.name: SensorLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging sensor data to a file, including initialization, data writing, and sensor name management based on debug modes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor logging process, setting up a listener for sensor updates.

methods.name: writeSensorLogLine
methods.description: Writes a line of sensor data to the log file, including timestamp and sensor values.

methods.name: startSensorLogFile
methods.description: Creates and initializes the log file, writes headers and sensor names based on debug mode.

methods.name: getSensorName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a sensor, with special names for debug float and int fields depending on debug mode.

methods.name: isPidDebugMode
methods.description: Determines if the current debug mode is one of the specified PID debug modes.
